propositions: Recalled findings are re-injected with hardcoded empty evidence and impact, losing grounding from the original finding and causing Pass-2 to rubber-stamp bare assertions instead of re-verifying them against current plan text.

The recall eligibility check selects only on decision and priority, ignoring whether a finding has persisted evidence; recalled findings are then re-verified, re-decided, and re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings, creating a self-feeding ratchet where evidence-empty injections re-qualify for recall every round.
Prior concerns with no persisted grounding evidence should be ineligible for recall, breaking the ratchet by excluding findings that are themselves products of prior recall injections.

Recall should be suppressed when the prior sidecar's material_fingerprint differs from the current one, since on changed material the fresh finder's silence is evidence the edit resolved the finding, not a miss.

A recalled candidate must carry the original finding's persisted evidence and impact into the injected candidate so Pass-2 re-grounds the claim against the current plan text instead of confirming a bare assertion.
